load_ytvos_dataset: load a YouTubeVIS annotation JSON file into a YTVOS API object for querying videos, categories, and annotations
get_ann_ids_by_filter: get annotation IDs filtered by video IDs, category IDs, area range, or crowd label using getAnnIds
get_cat_ids_by_name: get category IDs filtered by category names, supercategory names, or existing category IDs using getCatIds
convert_annotation_to_mask: convert a YouTubeVIS annotation segmentation to a binary numpy mask for a specific frame using annToMask
load_results_and_evaluate: load algorithm result annotations from a JSON file into a YTVOS result object for evaluation using loadRes
